app.title: LuminaryWorks Account Center
auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Use your LuminaryWorks account. Password and security settings stay with the identity provider.
auth.notConfiguredDesc: Runtime /config.json needs an issuer and client id. Register LuminaryWorks Account Center, then set ACCOUNT_CENTER_IDP_CLIENT_ID. No client secret belongs in the browser.
auth.termsLead: I have read and agree to the
errors.paymentRequired: Commercial entitlement failed (402). This is not a permission error.
confirm.title: Confirm
profile.title: Profile & security
profile.lead: These fields come from your sign-in token. Password, MFA, and sessions are managed by the identity provider.
profile.name: Name
profile.idpLead: Open the identity provider to change your password or security settings. This page does not store or reset passwords.
profile.idpMissing: The identity provider account URL is not configured.
billing.title: Subscriptions & billing
billing.lead: Plans and the entitlements on your account. Orders, invoices, and refunds appear when those read APIs exist.
billing.audience: The sign-in token is issued for the AI Platform. Entitlement may reject it until that API accepts the same audience.
billing.noAppsDesc: Add partner apps to /config.json to load entitlements per product.
billing.ordersUnavailable: A list of your orders is not available yet.
billing.invoicesUnavailable: Invoices and receipts are not available yet.
billing.refundsUnavailable: Refund status is not available yet.
wallet.title: AI wallet & usage
wallet.lead: Credits for hosted LuminaryWorks AI. Amounts are shown in credits (1 credit = 1,000,000 micro).
keys.title: AI keys
keys.deleteConfirm: Delete this provider key? Type its name to confirm.
apps.title: My apps
apps.lead: Open a product you use with this account.
apps.emptyDesc: The operator sets ACCOUNT_CENTER_APPS_JSON. Each entry is a separate product site.
legal.termsBody: This Account Center shows your LuminaryWorks profile, subscriptions, AI wallet, and provider keys. Partner products opened from My apps are independent services with their own agreements. Use is provided as-is.
legal.privacyBody: Sign-in is handled by LuminaryWorks identity. This app reads your token, entitlement snapshot, AI wallet, and the provider keys you save. Secrets are write-only and are not shown again.
ai.baseUrlRequired: OpenAI Compatible requires a base URL
ai.baseUrlListHint: Pick a region or plan URL, or type your own.
ai.purposeMultiHint: One connection can serve chat, transcription, and speech.
ai.vaultMissing: The server has no AI_VAULT_MASTER_KEY, so keys cannot be saved.
ai.managedUnavailable: Hosted models are not configured. You can still save, but calls will fail.
ai.switchProviderConfirm: Switching clears the unsaved name, model, base URL, and key.
ai.providerLocked: A saved connection cannot change provider. Create a new one.
ai.secretLocked: The stored key cannot be viewed. Create a new connection to replace it.
ai.secretRotateHint: Leave blank to keep the stored key. Enter a new key to rotate it.
ai.modelListHint: The provider default is selected. Add a key and leave the field to load the live list.
ai.modelListLive: Live models for this account are loaded. The first one is selected.
ai.modelListEmpty: No models yet. Add a key and refresh.
legal.platformBody: Identity, billing as merchant of record, and the AI gateway are provided by LuminaryWorks. The platform User Agreement and Privacy Policy also apply.
